messages.en:
{07 06 00}WHAAAA!!{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh, you finally
found me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
But it's too late!
{07 16 00}Time ran out a long time
ago!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 06 00}Wow, I was all worried
that I'd be here forever...
{07 14 00}But I won, so that makes it
all OK! {01 00 00 05 00}You should really
practice more!{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 06 00}MIIIDA!!{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh, sa lõpuks
leidsid mu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Aga liiga hilja!
{07 16 00}Aeg sai ammu
otsa!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 06 00}Vau, ma muretsesin,
et jään siia igaveseks...
{07 14 00}Aga ma võitsin, nii et kõik
on korras! {01 00 00 05 00}Sa peaksid
tõesti rohkem harjutama!{03 01 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Where have you been?!
We ran outta time, like, two
thousand years ago!
{07 00 00}Yeah, I know that makes me
a big winner and all, but...

{07 15 00}I can't BELIEVE I waited so
long!{01 00 00 05 00} I hope you go to jail
for ten years!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}{07 0d 00} Yaaay jail!{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ohh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kus sa olid?!
Meil sai aeg otsa, nagu,
kaks tuhat aastat tagasi!
{07 00 00}Jah, ma tean, et see teeb
minust suure võitja ja nii,
aga... 
{07 15 00}Ma ei USU, et ma nii kaua
ootasin!{01 00 00 05 00} Loodan, et sa lähed
aastateks vangi!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}{07 0d 00} Jeee!{03 01 00 01}
